# Custom Prompts for my-cv Project

Use these prompts when asking Copilot for help with specific tasks:

## Component Creation
```
Create a new [ComponentType] component in src/components/[folder]/[ComponentName].jsx that:
- Uses Tailwind CSS with the project's color palette (slate + blue accents)
- Is responsive (mobile-first with md:/lg: prefixes)
- Accepts customizable props like className for composition
- Follows the project's animation patterns
```

## Animation Implementation
```
Add a smooth [animation-type] animation to this component:
- Use Tailwind's animate-* utilities or define @keyframes in src/index.css
- Keep animation duration under 300ms for UI feedback, up to 800ms for entrance effects
- Include transition classes for smooth property changes
- Test performance on lower-end devices
```

## Layout & Responsive Design
```
Make this layout responsive following the project's approach:
- Start with mobile-first design (no media queries)
- Add md: (768px) and lg: (1024px) prefixes for larger screens
- Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44px on mobile
- Test on 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px viewports
```

## Styling & Visual Polish
```
Polish this component's styling to match the project's brand:
- Use the slate/blue color palette (bg-slate-50, text-slate-800, accent blue-600)
- Add subtle hover effects with transition classes
- Maintain visual hierarchy with font sizes and weights
- Ensure WCAG AA color contrast (4.5:1 for normal text)
```

## Performance Optimization
```
Optimize this component for the my-cv portfolio:
- Keep the component under 200 lines of JSX
- Identify any unnecessary re-renders and prevent them
- Minimize inline object/function creation
- Ensure the final bundle stays under 200KB gzipped
```

## Accessibility Audit
```
Ensure this component meets accessibility standards:
- Add semantic HTML tags (button, a, header, section, nav)
- Include proper ARIA labels where needed
- Verify keyboard navigation works
- Check color contrast against WCAG AA standards
- Test focus states are visible
```

## General Portfolio Help
```
I'm working on my software developer portfolio. It needs to:
- Showcase my projects and work experience to prospective employers
- Be visually impressive but simple and professional
- Load quickly and work on all devices
- Use React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS

Help me [specific task] while keeping these goals in mind.
```
